Missing Links is for an effective behaviour you intended but did not do. To understand an ineffective behaviour that did occur, use the [Behaviour Chain Builder](/skill-finder/behaviour-chain/).

This tree follows [General Worksheet 3: Missing-Links Analysis](/resources/clean/general/general-worksheet-3-missing-links-analysis-clean.pdf){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.
